create_Index: create a pandas Index from array-like data with specified dtype, copy, and name parameters
build_Index_join: build a pandas Index join between two indexes using left, right, inner, or outer join methods
test_Index_equals: test if two pandas Index objects are equal by comparing elements and their order
run_Index_sort_values: run a sorted copy of a pandas Index with optional ascending, descending, and na_position settings
create_Index_union: create the union of two pandas Index objects combining all unique elements from both
